description:
Adds an invoice: what a customer owes for a sale they didn't pay in full when it was made (a sale paid in full is a sales receipt). `customer_ref` is required. Each line in `invoice_line_add` names an `item_ref` and two of `quantity`, `rate` and `amount`; QuickBooks works out the third. An inventory item on an invoice lowers stock and posts its cost of goods sold. To invoice a sales order, link it with `link_to_txn_id`. The `add_transaction` workflow template finds the customer and items first and creates any that are missing.

The `invoice_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account
